name: Heavy Greater Magma · Fire ×2
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 4.25 ❤ fire + 6.25 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 10.8 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Launches upward
• Breaks up to 22 blocks within 2.17 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:

• Damage 2.25 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)

• Stone skin (Resistance III) for 16.5 s
